items.name: Dueling Pistol
items.description: Made for settling disputes when diplomacy fails, dueling pistols are finely crafted and made to fit easily into a holster or pocket. Noble and wealthy merchants in both Alkenstar and Dongun Hold often own matching pairs of dueling pistols in case they're called upon to address a challenge-though this practice has become increasingly rare in the modern age.

items.name: Obsidian Goggles
items.description:
The sleek, black lenses of these goggles somehow make everything seem more brightly lit. While wearing the goggles, you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks involving sight.

Activate—Darkvision 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect Adjusting your goggles, you gain darkvision for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Obsidian Goggles]

generalAbilities.name: I See You
generalAbilities.description: The peerless duelist's Perception checks and firearm Strikes ignore lesser cover and the Concealed condition.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shoot First
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An attacker the duelist can see targets them with a Strike or spell

Requirements The duelist is holding a loaded firearm

Effect The duelist makes a firearm Strike against the triggering creature. On a critical hit, they disrupt the triggering action.

defensiveAbilities.name: Threatening Aura
defensiveAbilities.description: 60 feet, DC 30 Will Saving Throw. The duelist's presence makes foes hesitate. Any enemy that enters or starts its turn in the aura must succeed at the Will save or be Stunned 1. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ace Shooter
offensiveAbilities.description: The peerless duelist deals an extra die of damage on any firearm Strike they attempt. This extra damage is already included in their dueling pistol Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Disarming Shot
offensiveAbilities.description:
The duelist fires a dueling pistol to attempt a Disarm an enemy at range with the bullet. The duelist attempts an attack roll with the dueling pistol instead of an Athletics check, taking any penalty appropriate for the firearm's range increment. The duelist doesn't have to meet the requirements of the Disarm action.

Instead of Disarming, the duelist can use Disarming Shot to attempt an Escape action for the benefit of themself or an ally within range.

offensiveAbilities.name: Double Reload
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The peerless duelist has an empty dueling pistol in each hand

Effect The peerless duelist Interacts to reload both dueling pistols.
